diagnostic_nuisance: expected random species-private median-hyperplane tanh edge contrast computed from geometry only
selection_rule: Select the first listed candidate whose maximum zero-shared rejection across amplitudes 0.5, 1, 2, 3 is <= 0.10 and whose full-shared amplitude-2 rejection is >= 0.80. If none passes, no v0.4 candidate is selected from this family.
candidate_lock_requirement: A selected development candidate must be implemented and frozen before any new external or RGFCA-reserve performance is opened.
confirmatory_requirement: The failed fresh animal panel can never qualify v0.4. Any v0.4 claim requires untouched confirmatory geometry. The frozen RGFCA reserve remains closed unless and until a v0.4 candidate is locked and any preceding external-confirmation requirement is satisfied.
